entries.reason: Correct preflight interpretation of the Classic waterfall's edge-to-edge terrain topology before the first model call.
entries.text: Topology correction: Render an orthographic edge-to-edge square terrain crop, not an isolated waterfall object or landscape scene. Preserve the Classic topology exactly: pale foam enters from the left edge and dominates the bottom, while cobalt and dark-blue water descends from the top edge and along the right edge. Keep the square fully occupied by water. Do not add a cliff, rocks, horizon, sky, banks, or any isolated object. The foam brightness is intrinsic water color, not a light source or lighting gradient
